market_summary: London session displays balanced, choppy conditions across all three pairs. EURUSD and US100 remain contained within their session Value Areas hovering near POC and VWAP with neutral-to-diverging CVD. BTCUSD swept Session Lows beneath VAL but lacks yellow RVOL expansion volume, presenting unfavorable scalp risk-reward across the board. Disciplined posture is HOLD on all assets.

signals.rationale: POC/VAH/VAL: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10786 to VAH 1.10998) and closed below POC (1.10943). CVD: +2,166 labeled NEUTRAL with negative slope (-1713.4), indicating fading buying pressure. SESSION: LONDON_SESSION. VWAP: Closed just above VWAP (1.10867) but live price is pressing right at VWAP. EMA50: Straddling EMA50 (1.10898) and EMA20 baseline (1.10906). ATR Band: Mid-channel between bands (1.10795 - 1.11017). RVOL: RVOL is 2.04 printing a yellow bar on the signal candle, but the candle itself is an indecisive red bar directly inside the value area. S/R: Below resistance at 1.11007 and above Prev Low support at 1.10824. Setup is conflicting and chop-prone inside value area, favoring HOLD.

POC/VAH/VAL: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 28086.57 to VAH 28185.57) and live price (28123.19) is hovering near POC (28121.92). CVD: -2.87 labeled BEARISH with flat slope. SESSION: LONDON_SESSION. VWAP: Closed above VWAP (28133.11), but live price has pulled back below VWAP and EMA50 (28160.87). ATR Band: Consolidating mid-channel. RVOL: Normal (1.173), no breakout volume (noting Dukascopy US100 volume caveat). S/R: Strong overhead resistance at Session High (28265.71) and support at S/R (28100.36). With price trapped squarely in the center of the session value area at POC, market is balanced. Action is HOLD.

POC/VAH/VAL: Price is trading below VAL (73295.04) and far below POC (73518.45). CVD: -0.05 labeled BEARISH with flat slope (0.0). SESSION: LONDON_SESSION. VWAP: Strong downward slope, price well below VWAP (73532.02) and EMA50 (73490.93). ATR Band: Price tested and pierced the lower ATR band (72873.64). RVOL: 1.591 (sub-2.0, lack of yellow expansion volume). S/R: The signal candle wicked down to Session Low (72639.7) and bounced back up to close at 72985.3, but the forming bar is already rejecting back down into the lower band area. Entering short into a fresh sweep of the lows without yellow RVOL confirmation carries high trap risk, while buying is against the macro trend. Action is HOLD.
